title: Big Flirt
overview: Edward is sweating over his poetry performance, all the while trying to get to know Max, and compete with the flirtatious Alex, the event’s snarky, but charming MC . Judy wants Ruth, but will her ex Penny, and Judy’s own knitted fashion choices get in the way? Ex-girlfriends, angry poets, rusty romantics, and a dash of imposter syndrome collide at a spoken word event in this LGBTIQ+ comedy short film/ pilot.
